notes.title: 1.02 Mental Update
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm bringing you a big new update that makes adjustments throughout the game based on feedback and self-testing, including critical fixes in the last part of the game and a lightened difficulty. I'm also bringing new Steam achievements, secret cheats waiting to be discovered, new house interactions, and lots of other little life quality changes.

[previewyoutube=V4Ow5Qem1F4;full][/previewyoutube]

Main Madness
[list]
[*]"Last Checkpoint" has undergone a thorough review and check. In a couple of cases, it was not possible to properly return to previous parts of the game. Fixed.
[*]Clickteam Fusion probably has a problem with the Steamworks object cooperation, which sometimes fails to save the necessary data for the game progress. Beta fixed.
[*]When a player is obsessed with the inner voice in an endless loop, sometimes after a long time it becomes impossible to leave it at all. Fixed.
[*]The player's inner voice in an endless loop is longer and more variable. With new takes, breaks etc.
[*]Added new interaction to different parts of the house. Will be adding more in future updates.

[*]The key to the chest in the attic will not disappear when unlocked. Fixed.
[*]At the end of the second act, if the player abruptly quits the game, the game will save incorrectly and lose tens of minutes. Fixed.
[*]Movement transition between Act 1 and Act 2 in Subconscious Cities is 25% faster. With transitions turned off in game settings, up to 50%.
[*]End of Act 3 - Persecution. Background is brighter and transitions between movements faster.
[*]The shotgun sequence in Act 4 is much easier for Gamepad and Regular Difficulty.
[*]The bloodlust effect is reduced in Act 4 (the effect of the Whisperer's influence). It was activated, though there was no reason for it. Fixed.
[*]The entire bossfight is easier in certain parameters for Regular Difficulty. If the player was groping, now there is no need!
[*]Act 5 - Bossfight Phase 2, right click on the mouse button and the player is taken to the Gameplay Showreel. Fixed. Stupid bug.
[*]Unlikely bug after bossfight appears in game data. The player can reach the end of the game without it being the right way to do so. Fixed.
[*]Towards the end of the game, a "Steamworks object" warning could appear, which was annoying. Fixed.
[*]For the final cutscene of the game, the movement/black screen could stutter and there was nothing to do but turn the game off. Fixed. 
[/list]

Menu, Other
[list]
[*]Screen shakes for a dramatic experience are less intense in the game. Well getting a seizure while playing is not a good gaming experience I suppose.
[*]Added a new option to the menu - Transitions OFF/ON. Ability to have no transitions into and out of darkness in the main game area, and in the Subconscious.
[*]Added 7 new Steam achievements, related to fighting with yourself in the last chapter of the game. 
[*]Game Difficulty option - individual difficulty levels are slightly overwritten.
[*]The text in Gore mode is somewhere more clear.
[*]The information skull in the menu also contains a tooltip for Level Select in the game settings.
[*]New secret cheats added to Extras. 
[/list]

Thank you very much for all the insights! With each update, the game becomes the masterpiece I wanted to present at release. If you find any bugs or have any comments or anything, feel free to contact me here in the discussions or other social platforms. Since then, ahoj!

notes.title: Minor but surely powerful Update! (1.011)
notes.notes:
Hey there! I'm bringing a new update that makes minor adjustments based on feedback and self-testing of the game.

[list]
[*]Some items will not disappear spontaneously during the game. And when they do, the player will be notified.
[*]In the basement, an unlikely player block could happen (direction to the secret room). Fixed.
[*]Phantom in Obscure City at the end of Act 2 will appear less frequently. Especially on Regular difficulty.
[*]Fragments of memories and conversations in Obscure City are more consistent to convey Anthony's subconscious situation.
[*]Minor overall changes in Act 3.
[*]Added a minor hint on the inability to interact with the inventory if the player is holding the body of the dead woman on their shoulders at the beginning of the third act.
[*]The shovel at the fresh grave in the final part of the sequence at the beginning of Act 3 has disappeared. Corrected. Additionally added minor interaction with it.
[*]The Axe will no longer be available in the house if the "Kill" option is chosen at the end of Act 3.
[*]Minor overall changes in Act 4.
[*]If the player makes the wrong decision in Act 4 to go to either the basement or the old bedroom, they will correctly receive the "Lust", possession by the Whisperer.
[*]Wrong decision in Act 4 in the cottage resulted in not being able to properly light the cottage on fire + the ability to leave. Fixed.
[*]For the first bossfight phase in Act 5, added a hint on how the mechanic of the 1st Source of Destruction works.
[*]Minor overall adjustments to Act 5, the bossfight, and the alternate endings of the game.

[*]The Start button on the gamepad can now also open and close pause screen!
[*]The intro text and notifications when starting the game will have a longer duration. The skip option remains the same.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback, as always! With your help, I can truly offer a very unique gaming experience.
If there are any other bugs, please feel free to tell me about them in any form, I would be very grateful.

notes.title: 1.01 Fixfest Update
notes.notes:
Sup guys. This particular update addresses various issues, bugs and glitches of the whole game. I'm also bringing some difficulty balance, making the Regular more simpler. Also got some new features and etc.

Murderous Changes
[list]
[*]Texts about possible interaction in space added to Subconscious Cities (Act 1-2). Just as there are texts in the house.
[*]New information feature - Will. Although it is an optional option in the game settings, the player learns who currently controls the main character's will. Conscience has the most scope, the Anthony character less so, and interaction with the Whisperer is noticeably more limited. With a change of will comes a different gameplay.
[*]Overall numerous fixes to the game, specifically listed below.
[/list]

Overall
[list]
[*]Broken matches at the chat sequence in Chapter 4 that block the player from continuing. Fixed.
[*]A solid difficulty balance to the game, especially for the REGULAR difficulty, which is much calmer (something for every chapter, especially the bossfight). This is especially true of Act 2 for the Gallery and the Voice in general, Act 4 for the Bridge and A View sequences, and Act 5 for Bossfight Phases 1 and 2.
[*]Time limiting game sequences (2 act, 5 act) are more player friendly, more on regular difficulty.
[*]Added more specific explanations of what to do if a player fails multiple times (Obscure Town in Act 2, Bossfight Phase 1).
[*]A minor redesign of the Whisperer's absorption in the third act and a bad endgame. With extra info text on what's going on.
[*]The player is warned in advance in the menu that the difficulty is set to UNSANE, i.e. a game with an invisible mouse. 
[*]Reduce the possibility that a player will mysteriously manage to glitch in Introduction after clicking on the New Games button. 
[*]The board game, because of its repetitiveness, is only in Chapter 2 once.
[*]When the player is fully possessed by the Whisperer, he gets an infinite loop that can sometimes improbably break. Fixed.
[*]Significantly reduce the probability of values from objects from gameplay entering the game menu. For example, the screen will be blacked out.
[*]Fixed cursor functionality and clearer transitions between images for the Obscure City in Act 1, and for the Gallery, the Obscure City in Act 2.
[*]Added new images to Obscure City at the end of Act 2 for better orientation in space.
[*]The item icons in the inventory are "remastered" to the aesthetics of the game. (Based on 5 year old visuals, hh)
[*]When the player initially encounters a possible interaction in the Cut Yourself scene, they will see a briefing text about the first possible interaction.
[*]Updated demo version of the game.
[/list]

Menu, Other
[list]
[*]Limit Noise shader as a new option in game settings.
[*]Pixel Shader during gameplay is more limited for better clarity. Admittedly this is at the expense of clarity of the text, which was not meant to be seen every time, but the people decided.
[*]Gameplay Showreel content is slightly updated.
[*]Slightly revised Czech and English language. Mainly in the conversations in Act 1 and Act 2.
[*]Removed player location and story status (activated via mouse wheel, F1 key or Start on gamepad).
[*]Bold text will be part of the option in the "Text Readability" setting. It will be more prominent for sure. Sure turn it on.
[*]The game will not let the player into the basement in the tutorial, it will darken the screen. Fixed.
[*]Various minor bugs/glitches fixed also. But I suppose there are many more...
[/list]

Request for help
[list]
[*]I know it's weird, but a bug in the game's intro (the door/monologue sequence after clicking New Game) is preventing some players from playing the game at all. In all my time, not only has this never happened to me, but there's no reason for it to happen to anyone else. I've made a bunch of different checkers that should hypothetically fix this. But if it still happens to you after this update, can I ask you for some more in depth description/preferably a video of it? It would help me a lot. Sorry and thanks!
[/list]

Thanks for all your feedback, they are wonderful and hope u didn't trash the game prematurely. Enjoy!

notes.title: Yay, one-month anniversary! 1.006 Update
notes.notes:
Sup guys. This particular update addresses various issues of the whole game.

[list]
[*]Restricted access to the basement in Act 1 of the Interrogation sequence. Fixed.
[*]Missing "Turn around" option for one of the pictures in the basement. Fixed.
[*]Player has the option to leave the sequence when you find the woman at the door in Act 1. Fixed.
[*]Transitions sometimes missing in Act 1. Fixed.
[*]Skip Introduction is now without restrictions.
[*]Introduction is slightly modified so that it doesn't accidentally (for some players for no reason at all) cause a loop.
[*]Inner Voice and its visual limitation is more moderate in Act 2.
[*]Possible softlock at the subconscious door in Act 3 if the player leaves much sooner than they are supposed to. Fixed
[*]Added additional sounds, especially in Act 3.
[*]Fixed Interaction in "Persecution" at the "kill" selection at the end of the scene.
[*]Probable softlock in front of the cabin in Act 4. Fixed.
[*]Small things in the suicide sequences in Act 4 (incorrect texts, questionable movement when you wanted to activate Conscience, etc.). Fixed
[*]The "Key to the Attic" item could sometimes get stuck in inventory when going into the Subconscious. Fixed.
[*]The text in the Gameplay Showreel in the house does not disappear when moving to the next image. Fixed.
[*]When possessed by an inner voice in an infinite loop, the playthrough will inform the player that they are possessed and what to do.

[*]Guides about the game are now fully described until the final chapter. In case of trouble, you already know where to go!
[/list]

And I'll say it againly again! Thanks for all your feedback, they are wonderful and hope u didn't trash the game prematurely. Seeya

notes.title: Oh no, what's that? Update 1.003
notes.notes:
Greetings. This update is more minor and focuses more on various little things in the first three chapters of the game, as well as simplifying a few game segments that were unnecessarily frustrating for players who like to explore environments.

[list]
[*]Missing object bowl after interrogation with woman in basement, corrected.
[*]Wall of Shame in the Eavesdropping sequence didn't turn on after the people on the bench dialogue was clicked, fixed.
[*]Occasionally disappearing cursor on the ground, fixed.
[*]Light revision of The City at the Gallery in Act 2. The absorption of the inner voice will be slower. 
[*]Texts for the Door sequences in Act 2 will make the door slightly less visible for clarity when pointing the cursor at the question.
[*]"Lust" added to two situations in the 3. act. But It is only be more noticeable on Regular difficulty.
[*]Cursors in Act 3 were often overlapping or missing altogether, towards the end of the chapter. Corrected.
[*]Introductory notice when the game starts slightly modified.

[*] On side note: I'm gradually adding new act-by-act guides to the game's Steam Guide to better contextualize and describe what the player should do. Even with the video Walkthrough!
[/list]

And I'll say it again! Thanks for all your feedback, they are wonderful and hope u didn't trash the game prematurely.

notes.title: Update of Updates (1.002)
notes.notes:
Good evening. This second update of the game brings hopefully significant fixes and minor help when the player gets stuck where they shouldn't. You may ask why the game hasn't been fixed like that before? I'm asking that too...

[list]
[*]Minor revision of orientation in the house and the garden (and a proper labeling of rooms)
[*]"Last Checkpoint" finished to the whole game.
[*]Data should no longer be transferred from the acts to Level Select and vice versa.
[*]Potential softlocks in animation sequences (issue with game engine) are now fixed.
[*]If you collect enough fragments of memories or images, it can accidentally throw the player into one of the good endings of the game in the first act. And thus its slightly buggy after that. Fixed.
[*]Thrown out of the Gameplay Showcase if you are in the beginning of the story, fixed.
[*]If you move the body from Act 3 in the Level Select menu, the body stays with you for the entire game. Little morbid don't you think? Fixed.
[*]The door in chapter 2 may not have appeared correctly at times. Fixed.
[*]In order not to confuse the player unnecessarily, after questioning the woman, you will appear in the basement rather than on the ground floor.

[*]Double Click (or A + B on Gamepad) on Continue button in Menu to restart the actual progress in the currently playing act.
[*]Added a new menu icon (top left skull) to explain the function of the Last Checkpoint and other button options.
[/list]

Thanks for all your feedback, they are wonderful and hope u didn't trash the game prematurely.

notes.title: Quick Update (1.001)
notes.notes:
Hello! After two days from release I'm bringing some changes, that should help the game!

[list]
[*] When you first turn on the game, the first data should load correctly. Like sound volume and game presets in menu options.
[*] "Last Checkpoint" Added. If you somehow get stuck for unspecified reasons, you can go a little back in the story. For now it's still beta feature!
[*] Assistant Feature "The Lust" added. The player will be shown a potential direction in red colour to where to go. Only in 1 act.
[*] Added Skip Introduction. But only when if you get over the beginning to the basement first.
[*] The Whisperer Bad Ending in 2nd act deleted. Now you won't get the game over, but you will be limited in visibility for the length of the chapter.

[*] Very unlikely softlocks in 1. act (car scene) and in 3. act (burying scene) are now fixed.
[*] Possible getting stuck on the Introduction after New Game, is now fixed
[*] Broken Notes in inventory when you're carrying a body on your shoulders is now fixed.
[/list]

Thanks! See you next day

notes.title: Release date set for September!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello![/b]

Actually, first of all, I'm trying out how the various information and alerts work on Steam. Secondly, and most importantly, I want to announce that I have chosen September as the release date. I have yet to determine a specific date (nothing stopping me, I just can't choose :D). Other than that, I've created a new trailer, refreshed the game's page with new documentation and information, and updated the demo two months ago.

[previewyoutube=lJGrdEkzo70;full][/previewyoutube]

The time is slightly distant, although, to be honest, the game is almost done. This is mainly due to marketing the game over the summer, and of course various bug fixes and adding small details and such. 

Speaking of the author's diary, what am I missing from the game at the moment?

[list]
[*] Clearer in-game help. I know how to do it, in what way. I'm on it now.
[*] Improved orientation in space. It's a pressing issue that's difficult to resolve, but I want to tackle it.
[*] Lots of fixes from feedback I'm getting in many ways. I'm sure I'd elaborate it more specific many times over in later updates!
[*] Minor details - in-game scores (bizarre, I know), alternate paths and more extensive in-game interaction, different menu options, more cheats and integration with Steam achievements. 
[*] New better demo!
[/list]

Not much in the end result and the time ahead is very sufficient! I want to interact with you on many levels and communicate many insights, decisions and so on from my position as an indie developer. Feel free to feel free to ask anything! 

For now, that's all from me. 
Thank you very much for your attention, and let's kill merrily!
